description: Search for members of Congress by state, congress number, district, or get all current members. Supports: /member (all), /member/{stateCode} (by state), /member/{stateCode}/{district} (by district), /member/congress/{congress} (by congress), /member/congress/{congress}/{stateCode}/{district} (combined).

congress.description: Congress number. When used with state+district, filters to that congress. Use alone to list all members of a congress.

currentMember.description: Filter by current member status. true = current members only, false = former only

district.description: House district number (use with state). Returns all historical members for that seat.

state.description: Two-letter state code to filter by, e.g. 'CA', 'TX'. Can be used alone or with district.

name: congress_search_members
